title: Express Loading

reward.description: Brass-knuckled gloves with tiny pistons in every finger. Lifting crates feels like lifting teacups.

hints: A list comprehension looks like [expression for item in things if condition].
Dict comprehension: {key: value for name, kg in crates.items()}. Set comprehension: {x for x in things}.
[["."] * cols] * rows makes rows copies of the SAME list, so changing one row changes them all. Build a new list for every row: [["." for c in range(cols)] for r in range(rows)].
